title: Segregated theatres in his youth
summary: Pittsburgh had integrated neighbourhoods but segregated theatres; the road showed him the real world.

story.theme_name: Race and segregation in the jazz life
story.community_name: Segregation on the road and the bandstand

blocks.x: It's a funny thing about that. I come from a time that was very prejudiced. Of course, I didn't realize it. Oh, we were all in school together, you know, living next to each other in the same integrated neighborhoods. But, like, the theatres... You couldn't go to sit anywhere in the theatre you wanted, you know. We had like the last six rows for Negroes, you know. So we had all of that going. And...

No, it's like in the theatres over in town there, you had to sit in the balcony. But you didn't pay that any attention, you know. But when you'd get out there, you were really seeing what was really happening in the world, boy, it's scary, you know. Pshew!
